title: Adventurers Guild
tagline: SkyrimNet knowledge of the Adventurers Guild: its lore, its ranks, and your place in its ledger.
description:
Ships with the Adventurers Guild mod (AdventurersGuild.esp).

NPCs know the Guild's history and its troubles in Skyrim, each according to who they are: innkeepers who keep a Guild counter read your page of the ledger (rank, Reputation, reports waiting, how far you are from promotion); Companions, guards, soldiers, scholars and the Thalmor each know their side of the story. Guild ranks show on adventurers' bios, and your missives, dungeon clears and great kills become remembered events.

CONTENTS
knowledge/adventurers_guild_lore.sknpack  - the Guild's lore, targeted by faction
prompts/submodules/character_bio/0026_guild_rank.prompt  - guild rank, retired status, liaison duties and the player's ledger
prompts/submodules/guidelines/0511_guild_guidelines.prompt  - how ranks and the Guild work, for every NPC

The decorators (guild_rank_of, threat_rank_of, ag_player) and events come from AdventurersGuild.dll / AG_SkyrimNetInit.
author: adventurersguild
changelog: 1.13.0 (Adventurers Guild 1.5.0): missive boards, notice boards and monster hunt contracts are spoken of only when Missives, The Notice Board or Monster Hunt Missives is installed; a Guild counter pays off every hold's bounty for a small fee; boards post new work after a promotion; a liaison knows your bounty and whether the town's board has new work. 1.12.1 (Adventurers Guild 1.5.0): NPCs bring up the Adventurers Guild only when it fits the conversation, and its reps raise your record only when you bring Guild business (feedback from the SkyrimNet Discord). 1.12.0 (Adventurers Guild 1.5.0): hold stamps on the guild card, and what a hold's merchants make of them; an adventurer can show you their guild card (AG_ShowGuildCard); someone else's card is handed in at a Guild counter; the Jarls' bounties as Guild work, ranked and reported at a counter; the adventurers who died in Skyrim's dungeons and the bloodied cards they still carry; the Guild's running joke about a certain kind of party. 1.11.0 (Adventurers Guild 1.4.0): what S rank means (proven, never an ordinary foe or a wandering adventurer); a lore entry for Guild Augments and for tomes one rank above; a counter on Solstheim, kept by Geldis Sadri at the Retching Netch in Raven Rock; the Guild's scouts also sell the whereabouts of points of interest (Orc strongholds, standing stones, shrines, camps, landmarks, wrecks). 1.10.0 (Adventurers Guild 1.3.0): bios for the named adventurers (Sinmir, Uthgerd, Mjoll, Annekke), for Erik, for whoever keeps a counter after an innkeeper's death (Ysolda, Sorex Vinius, Nils, Talen-Jei) and for those who have to say a town's counter has closed; wandering adventurers on the roads know they are Guild members and behave like it; conduct (a bounty costs Reputation and holds promotion) and the three levels of Appraisal as common knowledge; a liaison knows your Appraisal level. 1.8.0 (Adventurers Guild 1.2.0): what each rank is trusted with, from E to S (knowledge pack); the guild card (a liaison knows when yours is lost, what a replacement costs, and can hand one over: AG_ReplaceGuildCard); notices from the hold notice boards as Guild work; parties of up to ten.
